userPrompt: Draft a polite reminder email about an overdue invoice.
responseText:
**Subject:** Gentle Reminder: Overdue Invoice [Invoice Number]

Dear [Client's Name],

I hope this email finds you well.

This is a polite reminder that Invoice #[Invoice Number], issued on [Invoice Date] for $[Amount Due], is now past due. Payment was originally due on [Due Date].

Could you please let me know when we can expect to receive the payment? If you have any questions or need a copy of the invoice, I’m happy to resend it.

Thank you for your attention to this matter. I appreciate your continued partnership.

Best regards,  
[Your Name]  
[Your Position]  
[Your Company Name]  
[Your Contact Information]
